project: Wuxia Life P116 Founding Patriarch Late-Life Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for founding_patriarch late-life, following P115 pressure implementation. Define branch direction, contract interfaces, and P117 validation shape. Docs-only; no runtime wiring.

userStories.title: Audit founding-patriarch late-life prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit so P116 starts from current runtime truths from P113 and P115.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize relevant flags, gates, branch markers, and expressions from P113 and P115
Clarify reusable surfaces vs missing late-life surfaces
Output prerequisite audit report under docs/test-reports
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Lock P116 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want P116 bounded as design-first to avoid accidental runtime implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, validation-shape planning
Define forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, unrelated route rewrites, system/UI changes
Output scope contract report under docs/test-reports
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Design late-life branch directions
userStories.description: As a designer, I want distinct late-life branch directions derived from pressure outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two branch directions based on pressure markers (rule_first and alliance_first)
Ensure branch semantics are meaningfully different and route-consistent
Recommend bounded event form (default single late-life event with branch variants)
Output direction comparison report
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define founding-patriarch late-life contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit contract so P117 can implement late-life without ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Define late-life checkpoint and trigger gates
Define event structure, branch keys, and expression signals
Define continuity constraints from pressure to late-life and late-life to endgame handoff
Save contract to docs/PRD/p116-founding-patriarch-late-life-contract.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define P117 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit validation expectations for next-stage playable implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Define targeted proof chain nodes for pressure to late-life continuity
Define minimum regression boundaries for P117
Define closure criteria count and pass threshold
Output docs/test-reports/p116-p117-validation-shape.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P116 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that hands off cleanly to P117.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize audit, scope, branch design, contract, and validation shape outputs
State GO or NO-GO for P117 with rationale

Save docs/test-reports/p116-founding-patriarch-late-life-closure-report.md
